articles.title: Tokenized assets are busier than the data shows
articles.snippet: When you strip out what was never mobile, correct for who's holding what and why, add back what works off-contract, the utilization of tokenized assets looks close to 20%, argues Katana’s Matthew Fisher.

articles.title: Kalshi takes legal blow in court ruling confirming state powers over prediction markets
articles.snippet: This latest U.S. appeals court ruling sets up a rift between federal courts on event contracts, suggesting the U.S. Supreme Court may need to settle the matter.

articles.title: UK Police Seize $1.4M in Bitcoin Traced to Shuttered Darknet Markets
articles.snippet: The 20.21 BTC was linked to marketplaces running between 2016 and 2019, and the man who held it died before it was forfeited.
